caption: The drawing depicts a maritime scene with a large sailing ship and a smaller boat on a turbulent sea, positioned against a light blue sky. The larger ship, located to the left of the center, has multiple masts with brown and beige sails unfurled, while the smaller boat is further background to the right, with a single prominent sail. The waves, rendered in shades of blue, white, and brown, appear to be rough and flow diagonally across the composition. On the left foreground, there are dark brown and maroon rocky outcrops. On the right side of the image stands a tall lighthouse colored in shades of beige, brown, and white, with windows depicted in black and blue. The word "SANDY - HOOK" is written in brown, capital letters in the upper right quarter of the image, above the boats. The overall color scheme uses predominantly light blue for the sky and water, contrasted by browns, whites, and maroons for the ships, rocks, and lighthouse.
title: Bandbox
